ideas.idea: Add the actual routes with grades as text on the guides page, ideally each on its own page/URL
ideas.why: guides.vue only has a promise sentence and no route content, so adding real content and URLs gives crawlers and readers something to find.

ideas.idea: Add more descriptive text to the home page and link to specific walks
ideas.why: index.vue has only an h1 and a button, so a short description and real links would help understanding and discovery.

ideas.idea: Declare site domain and add canonical link on each page
ideas.why: No canonical or site URL is set anywhere in the config, and the sitemap uses a placeholder host.

ideas.idea: Add WebSite/Organization JSON-LD with site name and URL
ideas.why: Accurate since there is no JSON-LD, but it would have little effect on a small site like this.

ideas.idea: Add lastmod to sitemap entries or use @nuxtjs/sitemap generator
ideas.why: It's accurate, but with two URLs lastmod has little effect, and the report itself says to add dates only once real update dates exist.

ideas.idea: Replace placeholder sitemap host trailhead.example with the real domain
ideas.why: sitemap.xml uses https://trailhead.example/, which would point crawlers at a non-existent host.

ideas.idea: Remove the sitemap/noindex contradiction by removing the header rule for /guides
ideas.why: This is the known noindex header problem restated, so it's excluded as already graded, but flagged as a duplicate.
